name: KARTHIK BIBIREDDY
headline: Senior Software Engineer | Large-Scale Distributed Systems | Agentic AI Workflows
introduction: Hi, I'm Karthik. I am a senior software engineer and AI operator. I have {{careerTenure}} of experience building reliable systems across embedded software, frontend applications, backend services, and distributed infrastructure.

At Amazon, I lead engineering for batch and event-driven pricing systems that span more than 600 million products worldwide. I migrated an approximately 8 million QPS service across regions with no customer downtime, secured network egress by diverting traffic from NAT gateways to private VPC endpoints and cutting NAT usage by approximately 90%, and built AI workflows that reduced initial on-call triage time by 30%. Earlier in my career, I built real-time computer vision products and fault-tolerant aerospace software on NASA Core Flight Systems.
Outside of work, I spend time with my family and my dog, Odin. I hike in the Pacific Northwest, play soccer, and experiment with electronic music.
professionalSummary: Senior software engineer with 9+ years building distributed streaming and batch systems at Amazon and startups. I own high-scale customer-facing services on AWS, lead multi-region migrations and system design, tune event-driven pipelines, and drive team-wide adoption of agentic AI workflows.

workExperience.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
workExperience.summary: At Amazon I grew from Alexa Automotive into owning customer-facing pricing infrastructure at global scale. I shipped conversational car control, Teachable AI, and C++ in-car messaging with OEMs including Lamborghini, Rivian, and Lucid, then took ownership of Spark, EMR, and Scala pipelines that power strikethrough prices and price history across 600M+ products worldwide. I led a zero-downtime multi-region migration for an ~8M QPS list-price service processing 200M+ records/day, secured network egress by diverting traffic from NAT gateways to private VPC endpoints, cutting NAT usage ~90%, designed a unified pricing config platform with safe previews, and built AI-first internal tools that cut initial on-call triage time by 30%.
description: Sole owner of a zero-downtime, multi-region infrastructure migration for a customer-facing list-price validation service built as a hybrid of event-driven and streaming pipelines. Rebuilt the full IaC stack with AWS CDK, secured network egress by diverting traffic from NAT gateways to private VPC endpoints, reducing NAT usage by roughly 90% (from 470GB to 6GB), and lowered capacity concentration risk while maintaining 99.9% data accuracy and zero downtime on a service that processes 200M+ records per day worldwide and serves approximately 8M QPS across Amazon domains.

Built various AI-first apps used across Amazon, including Text Forge (~100 DAU, ~550 LLM-backed transforms/day) for one-click text cleanup and transformations, Chart Forge for converting plain-text and tabular data into time-series charts, and an AI ticket-labeling tool for semantic classification with trend analytics, adopted by Pricing Support teams as an early-warning signal for systemic issues. Also architected multi-stage on-call triage that has processed ~5,000 tickets in 10 months and cut initial triage time by 30%.

Designed a unified configuration platform so pricing teams can manage business rules in one place instead of across code, batch jobs, and separate config stores. I owned the full architecture, including the data model and a novel versioning and cascade mechanism that lets program managers simulate and test configuration changes before production rollout. This centralization reduces configuration errors and review time by enabling safe previews before changes go live.

Own Spark, EMR, and Scala batch pipelines and real-time streaming systems that power strikethrough prices and price history across 600M+ products worldwide. Day to day, I evolve computation and validation logic end to end, including updates for regional rules and compliance.

On Alexa Automotive, I delivered conversational car control and Teachable AI so customers can personalize voice commands (for example, 'I am hot' or 'set temperature to cozy'). I served as SME for the offline embedded car-control skill, improved prompt quality, and built target-device resolution using a scoring and reranking layer on top of Clucene. With a partner team, I shipped C++ messaging middleware that syncs SMS and WhatsApp messages to the in-car HUD. These features launched with major OEMs including Lamborghini, Stellantis, Lucid, and Rivian.

workExperience.title: Software Engineer
workExperience.summary: At Algoface I owned real-time computer vision for face tracking and AR virtual try-on on web and mobile. I led WebAssembly performance work across TypeScript and C++ inference layers to cut latency and smooth rendering, scaled containerized cloud infrastructure with monitoring and CI/CD, and partnered with enterprise customers to ship production integrations.
description: Architected and deployed computer vision services for real-time face tracking and AR virtual try-on across web and mobile experiences.
Led WebAssembly performance optimization initiatives, improving latency and rendering smoothness through precision tuning and memory efficiency work.
Worked across TypeScript frontend and C++ inference layers to optimize integration boundaries, data flow, and runtime stability in browser environments.
Maintained and scaled cloud infrastructure with containerized deployments, monitoring, and CI/CD practices to improve reliability and release consistency.
Collaborated directly with enterprise customers to deliver production-grade integrations for reliable inference workloads.

workExperience.title: Software Engineer
workExperience.summary: At Windhoverlabs I built aerospace software from operator tools through flight systems. I shipped 3D mapping and real-time aircraft tracking, a Primary Flight Display broadcasting drone telemetry over UDP, and fault-tolerant C++ on NASA Core Flight Systems, with peer review, automated tests, and flight-trial validation.
description: Developed aerospace ground-control software with 3D geolocation mapping and real-time aircraft tracking, enabling low-latency telemetry visualization.
Built a Primary Flight Display using JavaScript/Node.js, broadcasting drone telemetry over UDP for real-time monitoring and operator decision support.
Implemented critical airliner systems components (Landing Gear software, Video Controller, Vehicle State Manager) to improve reliability and maintainability.
Ensured C++ flight software on NASA Core Flight Systems met standards for fault tolerance, redundancy, and real-time operation.
Improved quality through peer reviews, automated test coverage, and field validation during flight trials.

projects.title: Technical Analysis Platform for Financial Markets
description: Building a personal platform to backtest and analyze trading strategies using historical financial data, with event-driven AWS Lambda workflows, ETL pipelines for sentiment and technical analysis, and a React-based dashboard for strategy evaluation and performance tracking.

projects.title: Closed Captioner iOS App
description: iPhone live-captioning app with a peer-to-peer Huddle mesh that streams messages between nearby phones over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi with no server.

projects.title: Back of the Envelope Math
description: In-browser system-design calculators for storage sizing and capacity planning. Paste a sample payload to estimate UTF-8 footprint, scale from 1 to 1B records with YoY growth, convert DAU or RPS into peak throughput and bandwidth, and use ByteByteGo-aligned cheat sheets. All math stays on-device.

projects.title: Real Estate Investment Analysis Tool
description: Developed a web-based tool to evaluate real estate investment opportunities by comparing buying vs renting, incorporating inputs like purchase price, interest rate, taxes, and ownership costs to output projected ROI, breakeven points, and overall investment value in a clean, user-friendly interface.

projects.title: Compensation Planner
description: Built an in-browser planner for modeling multi-year job offers and negotiation scenarios, with slider-driven base, bonus, equity vesting, and signing-bonus inputs, plus scenario search, timeline charts, and package distribution views. All calculations stay on-device.
